scope: Eight development panels only; no held-out images, degree sequences or alignment fits consulted during visual readback. Same agent, previously exposed; not independently blinded human annotation. First two whole-panel images and first-pass script inspected before this protocol.
method: Use image-only crops with location IDs and source context, no prior feature values on sheets. Record visible garment/bare/uncertain and vessel/absent/uncertain with evidence; compare to frozen old labels after saving observations. Rotation/cropping for inspection only; original pixels remain reference. Approximate existing locations may misregister; do not resolve from old classification.
criteria: Garment requires visible neckline/sleeve/fabric structure; paint alone insufficient. Bare requires readable exposed torso anatomy/contour without garment structure. Vessel requires rim and containing wall around lower body; a decorative border alone insufficient. Unclear, occluded or cut-off remains uncertain. Presence uncertainty remains separate. No sex inference, glyph reading or pigment classification.
no_scoring: No alignment scoring or new winning rule in this audit. Revised features require a separately frozen subsequent application.
